s: The brave knight rode his horse to the castle.
def: A soldier of high rank who served a king long ago.

s: She wears her watch on her left wrist.
def: The joint between your hand and your arm.

s: We like to climb the big tree in the yard.
def: To go up something using your hands and feet.

s: He hurt his thumb while closing the door.
def: The short, thick finger on the side of your hand.

s: She scraped her knee falling off the bike.
def: The joint in the middle of your leg.

s: Please listen carefully to the directions.
def: To pay attention to a sound.

s: They sailed to a small island in the bay.
def: A piece of land with water all around it.

s: I got only one answer wrong on the quiz.
def: Not correct.

s: He cracked a knuckle on his right hand.
def: A joint in your finger.

s: The puppies like to wrestle on the carpet.
def: To struggle or grapple with someone.

s: Use the scissors to cut along the line.
def: A tool with two blades used for cutting.

s: The drummer kept a steady rhythm.
def: A regular repeated pattern of sound or movement.

s: Add the numbers in the first column.
def: An upright pillar, or a vertical list.

s: An honest person tells the truth.
def: Truthful and fair.

s: Running builds muscle in your legs.
def: Tissue in the body that makes it move.

s: I have no doubt that she will win.
def: A feeling of not being sure.

s: Her knowledge of astronomy impressed the teacher.
def: Information and understanding you have gained.

s: We saw the silhouette of a bird against the sunset.
def: A dark outline of something seen against light.

s: The doctor treated his pneumonia with medicine.
def: An illness that causes the lungs to become infected.

s: There was a subtle change in the color of the sky.
def: So slight it is hard to notice.

s: His conscience told him to return the wallet.
def: The inner sense of right and wrong.

s: He kept a clean handkerchief in his pocket.
def: A small square of cloth used for wiping your face.

s: The beaver will gnaw through the small tree.
def: To bite or chew on something over and over.

s: The ceremony was quiet and solemn.
def: Very serious in manner.

s: What will happen if we mix the two colors?
def: To take place or occur.

s: We eat dinner together every evening.
def: The main meal of the day.

s: They swim at the lake all summer.
def: The warmest season of the year.

s: One button fell off his shirt.
def: A small disk used to fasten clothing.

s: A rabbit hopped across the garden path.
def: A small furry animal with long ears.

s: She finished the jigsaw puzzle in one hour.
def: A game or problem that tests your cleverness.

s: Please sit in the middle seat.
def: The center point or part.

s: Today's lesson is about fractions.
def: Something taught or learned.

s: The beginning of the story was exciting.
def: The first part or the start.

s: The bus stopped at the corner.
def: Past tense of stop; came to an end.

s: We watched the lake shimmer in the sunlight.
def: To shine with a soft wavering light.

s: Do not embarrass your friend in front of others.
def: To make someone feel awkward or ashamed.

s: The storm occurred late in the night.
def: Happened or took place.

s: The committee met to plan the school fair.
def: A group of people chosen to do a job together.

s: She goes swimming every Tuesday.
def: Moving through water using your arms and legs.

s: We watched the horse gallop across the field.
def: To run fast, the way a horse does.

s: The hotel can accommodate forty guests.
def: To provide room or space for.

s: It is necessary to bring a pencil to the test.
def: Needed; required.

s: The two parallel lines never meet.
def: Side by side and always the same distance apart.

s: A millennium is one thousand years.
def: A period of one thousand years.

s: Do not exaggerate how big the fish was.
def: To make something seem larger than it really is.

s: That old book is her favorite possession.
def: Something that a person owns.

s: He ate the broccoli with his dinner.
def: A green vegetable with a thick stalk.

s: Wear appropriate shoes for the hike.
def: Suitable or right for the situation.

s: She took quick action to help.
def: The process of doing something.

s: The train pulled into the station.
def: A place where trains or buses stop.

s: Raise your hand if you have a question.
def: A sentence that asks for information.

s: Their mission was to plant one hundred trees.
def: An important job or task.

s: We go to the beach every summer vacation.
def: A period of time away from school or work.

s: The gentle motion of the boat made her sleepy.
def: The act of moving.

s: Read the first section of the chapter.
def: One part of something larger.

s: Canada is a large nation.
def: A country and its people.

s: Making that decision took a long time.
def: A choice you make after thinking.

s: Please pay attention to the instructions.
def: Careful thought or focus.

s: She mailed an invitation to every classmate.
def: A written or spoken request to attend something.

s: The conclusion of the story surprised me.
def: The end, or a judgment you reach.

s: The whole town joined the celebration.
def: A party or event held to honor something.

s: A puzzled expression crossed his face.
def: A look on the face, or a way of saying something.

s: The population of the city keeps growing.
def: The number of people living in a place.

s: Write a description of your favorite place.
def: An account in words of what something is like.

s: The pronunciation of that word is tricky.
def: The way a word is spoken.

s: The reading comprehension test had ten passages.
def: The ability to understand something.

s: The transmission of the signal was clear.
def: The act of sending something from one place to another.

s: The museum opened a dinosaur exhibition.
def: A public display of art or objects.

s: It took gentle persuasion to change his mind.
def: The act of convincing someone.

s: The library announced the acquisition of rare maps.
def: Something gained or bought.

s: She had a suspicion that the cat took the yarn.
def: A feeling that something may be true without proof.

s: Measure every dimension of the box.
def: A measurement such as length, width, or height.
